regions.full_page: Pneumonia - & Spinalmenigitis. Francis Jos. Milton 33 of 15124 Men- dotte Ave. hopelessly ill of pneumonia is enrolled (Wednesday) June 15th. Friday night 17th is given 48 to live - having spinal-meni- gitis. Sunday 19th 11.30 A.M. reported "Doctors Hopeless." .

regions.full_page: Samuel Golunlo 40, (2107 Jos. Compo) not to Holy Communion since Married in 1923 brought to Monastery last Sunday July 3, A.M. not able to speak: All he could do was cry and make signs. Wife and friends in consternation: They enroll him for 2 years promising all to go to weekly communion till 1928. To-day they all return praising God - Samuel has relief telling that on Monday he was able to talk. He went to confession and Holy Com. Tuesday and now is all smiles. --- Deo Gr.

regions.full_page: Edward Murph 13 of 1041 E. 47th St. Chicago now blind since one year old: comes To-day with Aunt (Mrs. Nora Dwyer) and is enrolled per- petually. Edward took 4th prize in class of 74 recently Now about to enter High School. He hopes, God willing if able to see to be a priest.
